verdict.rationale: Chroma's homepage claims multi-cloud/multi-region replication and point-in-time recovery for BYOC/Cloud deployments. Community commentary adds that Chroma Cloud offers distributed scaling over S3-backed object storage. The evidence is a single marketing-level claim with no documented consistency model and nothing on replication for self-hosted OSS. Missing for 10: documented consistency model (e.g. read-after-write or eventual guarantees), technical replication/failover docs, self-hosted multi-node replication, independent or hands-on corroboration of HA behavior.
